profile.about: I am a software engineer with a degree in Game and around five years of professional Unity/C# game development experience, building gameplay, multiplayer, and reusable application systems. My recent work has expanded my production software engineering capabilities through enterprise architecture, API and data integration, and applied AI workflows using OCR, LLMs, structured output, validation, and normalization. My long-term direction is to combine these backgrounds in Game AI, with particular interest in intelligent agents, procedural content generation, adaptive gameplay, and AI-assisted game systems.

interests.title: Game AI
interests.description: AI operating inside gameplay systems, using player experience, game state, explicit rules, and measurable objectives rather than AI-generated graphics.

interests.title: Procedural Content Generation
interests.description: Generation of skills, classes, and other game content from reusable structured components while keeping outputs valid, varied, controllable, and rule-consistent.

interests.title: AI-assisted Game Systems
interests.description: AI used alongside structured game components, explicit constraints, validation, balance evaluation, and simulation inside authored game systems.

interests.title: Intelligent Agents
interests.description: Agents that perceive game state, reason about available actions, and make meaningful decisions under gameplay constraints.

interests.title: Adaptive Gameplay
interests.description: Gameplay systems that respond to player behavior or performance while preserving fairness, clarity, and design intent.

interests.title: Multi-Agent Systems
interests.description: Interactions among multiple autonomous agents operating under shared rules, resources, environments, and objectives.

research.statement: My primary interest is AI for rule-driven gameplay systems, particularly procedural generation and intelligent systems that operate under explicit game constraints, simulations, and measurable gameplay objectives.

direction.title: Generative Class & Skill System for Fantasy RPG
direction.question: How can a hybrid Generative AI and rule-validation system generate class and skill candidates from gameplay experience while keeping outputs valid, balanced, diverse, and designer-controllable?
direction.supportingStatement: This proposed research concept explores how gameplay experience, structured components, explicit game constraints, and simulation-based evaluation could be combined in a focused Fantasy RPG prototype.
